beats.narration: Your car dies at stoplights — and it's not the battery.
beats.visualPrompt: Static wide shot of a car stopped at a red light at dusk, brake lights glowing, subtle idle vibration visible in the frame, static-mounted camera.

beats.narration: Idle feels rough, or the RPM bounces up and down while you're stopped.
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up on a tachometer needle oscillating/hunting between roughly 500-1500 RPM; cut to a low-angle idling-engine-bay shot with visible micro-vibration.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two ~2.5s sub-shots before real generation to satisfy the 1.5-2.5s visual-change cadence.

beats.narration: One clue: a dirty idle air control valve. It manages airflow when your foot's off the gas.
beats.visualPrompt: Macro/cutaway shot: an idle air control valve removed from a throttle body, resting on a workbench, visible carbon/soot buildup on the plunger tip, slow push-in.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two sub-shots (wide + macro push-in) before real generation.

beats.narration: When it gets clogged with carbon, idle gets unstable — sometimes enough to stall.
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up on a throttle body bore with visible carbon deposits ringing the opening, shop-light glare, static hold; cut to the tachometer needle dropping toward stall.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two sub-shots before real generation.

beats.narration: Don't just replace the battery and hope. Get the idle system checked.
beats.visualPrompt: Scan tool connected via cable under the dash, idle-RPM data scrolling on-screen, shop bay softly blurred in the background.

beats.narration: Worth checking before it strands you at a light. Stop by and we'll take a look. Nick's Tire & Auto.
beats.visualPrompt: Branded end-card plate: Nick's Tire & Auto shop bay wide shot, warm daylight, static hold.
